_comment: DUN003 MAP A, ch. 02, storyboard shot 19 (in 69.12 s, 6.4 s on screen; rendered 8.0 s with handles). VO: 'Without spice, the Spacing Guild cannot navigate. Layout v2: no dashed return route, and the Guild sits above the Empire so routes don't cross the labels.
